title: Check progress of a running dd command
summary: If you started a `dd` command without `status=progress`, you can check its progress by sending a signal to the process from another terminal window.
prerequisites: A `dd` command is currently running in another terminal window

steps.explain: Send a SIGINFO signal to the running `dd` process to display its current progress in the original terminal window.
steps.expect: The original terminal window running `dd` will print a line showing the number of bytes transferred and the transfer rate.
